# Claim Responder queues jobs for team PRs that need no claim action

## Context

During the v14 release pass, approved Engine PRs showed a pending Claim Responder check after their required build, test, and baseline checks passed. [One team-PR run](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/actions/runs/45029782702) waited 56m 53s for setup, then executed in nine seconds. Its script determined the author was on the team.

## The problem

Team-authored open, reopen, and edit events occupy the same serialized queue as contributor claims and merged-close notices. The unnecessary jobs deepen the queue and leave yellow status indicators on reviewed PRs.

## The fix

At the Claim Responder job condition, skip open, reopen, and edit events when GitHub reports a known team author association. Use the same association list as `isOutsidePrAuthor()`. Preserve close processing and the runtime collaborator-permission fallback for hidden membership.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Team-associated PR open, reopen, and edit events skip the responder job before it claims a runner.
- [ ] Outside and ambiguous-author events still reach the existing runtime policy, and team merged-close events can still notify competing contributor PRs.
- [ ] The existing queue, trusted source loading, contributor permissions, and required check contexts retain their current contract.

The open issue and PR sweep found no equivalent repair. Related historical timing and Actions policy are linked in [the existing policy issue](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/21069). The board overflow decision stays with [Ideas #21955](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/discussions/21955).
